Cold has fogged the panel and the kraft has gone two shades darker where fingers and condensation touched it, one bead tracking the seam. A rolled oatmeal linen shirt cuff sits out of focus across the bottom-left, cut by the left edge. ORCHARD OAT is letterpressed small into the uncoated board, the ink feathering into the fibre, a hand-inked date stamped crooked beneath it.
